summary: Code review PASS. All touched code is clean, idiomatic, and consistent with established project patterns.
composer.json: seed-tests entry at line 154 is correctly positioned alongside other test-related script entries. Entry format matches all other ComposerScripts entries exactly.

ComposerScripts::seedTests(): Correct ordering — APP_SEED_MODE is defined before self::init() ensuring the bootstrap guard fires before configureUsers() is reached. The seedTests()/doSeedTests() split follows the established do* pattern (9 prior do* methods in the class).
TestSuiteBootstrap::_boot(): APP_SEED_MODE guard at line 41 is minimal and correct — skips configureUsers() only when explicitly seeding, leaving all normal PHPUnit runs unaffected.

TestSuiteBootstrap::seedSystemUsers(): Transaction pattern is correct (start → process → commit, rollback on Throwable). rollbackConditional() is the right choice for resilience. docblock is thorough and includes @see ComposerScripts::seedTests() (AC3). Re-throws Throwable cleanly.
No blocking issues. No fix-forward changes applied. One documentation-forward item recorded for the Documentation agent.
AC4/AC5/AC6 remain deferred to manual live-DB verification as handed off by QA — these do not block review approval.

comments.note: No observations — code is clean and consistent. The seedTests()/doSeedTests() split is a natural extension of the established do* pattern (9 existing do* methods). The APP_SEED_MODE constant guard in _boot() is minimal and correct. The transaction pattern in seedSystemUsers() follows best practice with rollbackConditional() ensuring safety even if no transaction is active.

[documentation-forward] ComposerScripts::doSeedTests() is public (per the do* pattern) but has no docblock note warning that direct callers must define APP_SEED_MODE and call self::init() before invoking it — otherwise _boot() will not skip configureUsers() and the seed will fail if users are already absent. A brief @internal or @note in the docblock would prevent misuse.

summary: Addressed the documentation-forward item from the Reviewer: added an inline warning to the doSeedTests() docblock in ComposerScripts.php. No other documentation gaps were identified — the README and existing docs accurately reflect the implementation."
